statement_en: Let $a_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $b_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$. If $a_n$ decreases monotonically to $0$, and there exists a positive real number $M$ such that $\left|\sum_{n=1}^N b_n\right|<M$ for every positive integer $N$, then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n b_n$ converges.
callout_body: $a_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R},b_n:\mathbb{N} \to\mathbb{C}$,如果$a_n$单调收敛到0,并且存在正实数使得$\left|\sum_{n=1}^N b_n\right|<M$对任意正整数$N$成立，那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_nb_n$收敛。
